_description: Goal thresholds, merged over thresholds.json when --require-goals is passed. Under --require-goals EVERY unmeasured threshold is a FAIL, so run --scenario all with UBAG_LOAD_API_KEY_B set. Voice: max_voice_relay_p95_ms is fed by --voice-latency <report from the Go in-process relay bench> (docs/load-testing.md); it is gateway-side frame age only, loopback numbers are NON-AUTHORITATIVE, and omitting the report leaves it unmeasured, which fails. Steady-state values come from the steady-state scenario (constant create rate plus a dedicated GET mix), never from the 100-client burst. Numbers from a laptop/Docker stack are NON-AUTHORITATIVE. min_memory_headroom_pct / max_oom_kills need --cgroup-containers (gateway, browser, worker) and a memory limit on every sampled container; an unlimited or unsampled container leaves them unmeasured, which fails.
